# FTIConvertConstrainedBasis

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIConvertConstrainedBasis`

Manual: [FTIConvertConstrainedBasis (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FTIConvertConstrainedBasis.md)

```text
FTIConvertConstrainedBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FTIConvertConstrainedBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --ground-file : name of the file corresponding to the state to be projected
    --degenerated-groundstate : single column file describing a degenerated ground state (all should be defined in the same source Hilbert space)
    -s, --nbr-subbands : number of subbands (default value = 1)
    --decoupled : assume that the FTI states are made of two decoupled FCI copies
    --source-allowed-orbitals : provide an ASCII file indicating which orbitals are allowed for the source Hilbert space
    --target-allowed-orbitals : provide an ASCII file indicating which orbitals are allowed for the target Hilbert space
    --target-max-band0 : maximum number of particles in band 0 for the target Hilbert space (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --target-max-band1 : maximum number of particles in band 1 for the target Hilbert space (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --target-max-band2 : maximum number of particles in band 2 for the target Hilbert space (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --target-max-band3 : maximum number of particles in band 3 for the target Hilbert space (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --target-min-band0 : minimum number of particles in band 0 for the target Hilbert space (default value = 0)
    --target-min-band1 : minimum number of particles in band 1 for the target Hilbert space (default value = 0)
    --target-min-band2 : minimum number of particles in band 2 for the target Hilbert space (default value = 0)
    --target-min-band3 : minimum number of particles in band 3 for the target Hilbert space (default value = 0)

output options:
    --output-file-name : string that will be used in the output file names (all system parameters will be automatically added))
    --normalize : normalized state once projected onto the target Hilbert space

precalculation options:
    --hilbert-directory : directory where Hilbert spaces should be read and stored (bypassing their construction)

tools options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
